addition.item: First release: alerts with a title, content, icon (a type's own, any UIkit icon or an image) and up to two buttons. Info, Success, Warning, Danger, Neutral or custom colours; Soft, Solid, Outline, Left border, Top border, Gradient or Glass styles; three sizes, corner radius, shadow, compact one-line layout and buttons beside or below the text.
Close button that hides the alert with a fade or slide, and can remember it for the browser session, a number of days or for good. A changed alert shows again.
Show from and Show until dates in the site's time zone, checked on the server, with an optional "Ends in" countdown that hides the alert when time is up.
A one-time Pulse or Shake to draw attention; screen readers hear Warning and Danger alerts straight away.
